packet.title: Choice coercion and a stale error description (implementation)

body.p: After and , which found the first, and (perf-7), which found the second.

item.p: Choice coercion: a function parameter of type (element(a) | xs:string) given xs:untypedAtomic("v") raises XPTY0004 (sxml xpath 'let $f := function($x as (element(a) | xs:string)) { $x } return $f(xs:untypedAtomic("v"))'). XPath 4.0, 3.4.2 (coercion rules) tries the alternatives of a choice in order, so the untyped value is cast to xs:string. The coercion engine counts the unchanged item as the first alternative's success ().

Stale description: after a try/catch catches FORX0002, a later LIMIT_EXCEEDED in the same query printed the caught error's description (): the error record is not cleared. Reproduce first (the sxml command has no step bound since ; use a regex step bound, a memory limit, or the C API with a small step bound); if it cannot be reproduced, record why.
Owns: src/evaluator_function.c, tests/evaluator_test.c, and the file that clears the error record after a caught error (find it; not src/xslt*.c or src/schematron*.c, which 7.28 holds).

Done when: both fixed with tests, each citing its section; QT4 XP40, XQ40 and XT40 whole: no outcome lost case by case (gains listed); the SchXslt expand stage of EN 16931 unchanged in output and not slower.

body.p: Done 2026-10-28 (): a CHOICE attempt succeeds only when its result matches the alternative; a catching task clears the error record once it handles the error. QT4 XP40, XQ40, XT40 whole: 0 outcomes differ; SchXslt expand unchanged in output and instructions.
